reviewContext.userProblem: The floating selection toolbar uses text buttons. It needs icon-only controls with hover tooltips and aria-labels, plus a Text disclosure for formatting the text of the selection.
requiredOutcomes: Icon-only buttons and summaries from the vendored Lucide set. The title equals the aria-label (actionTitle for actions). Toggles expose aria-pressed.
A unit test fails if any toolbar icon name is missing from the registry.

The Text disclosure covers font size steps with the current size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, horizontal alignment, and vertical alignment for text.note only. Each click is one setSelectionStyle undo step.
A DOM-free text-format module with unit tests.
Existing behaviour is kept. SelectionToolbar.css is self-contained and uses existing tokens only.
nonGoals: Changes to actions, the shortcut table, ContextMenu.tsx or the main toolbar
A new Command kind, a new dependency, or a new CSS custom property
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths, their progress file and their evidence directory. No git state changes, no any, no emojis.
mise run verify gets up to 3 attempts for deadline tests under load. Deadlines are never relaxed.
No push. Local commits only, with no tool attribution.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Icons come only from the vendored Lucide set through findIcon and renderIconMarkup, named in one TOOLBAR_ICONS record.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No hand-drawn paths and no new dependency. One key type makes the registry test cover every icon the toolbar uses (design 3.2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Text formatting logic lives in a DOM-free text-format.ts and writes only through editor.setSelectionStyle.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Unit-testable without the DOM. Each click is one undo step across every leaf reached through groups, with no new Command kind (design 3.1, 3.3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: All toolbar CSS moves into SelectionToolbar.css, scoped under .nodetto-selection-toolbar, and the .nodetto-float-* rules are removed from panels.css.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: ui-solid imports SelectionToolbar.css, so the hosted app gets the rules without edits to nodetto-cloud. Existing tokens with design-appearance 4.3 fallbacks keep both themes correct (design 3.4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Native title tooltips equal to aria-label; actions use actionTitle.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Meets the mouse-over requirement with the shortcut included and no extra tooltip component (design 3.3, 3.4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Two independent wave-1 plans (text-format, toolbar-icon) and one wave-2 wiring plan.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Dependencies follow real import contracts only; source write paths do not overlap.

intentionalTradeoffs: Clicking the implicit default vertical alignment 'top' while unset writes 'top' explicitly; it looks the same.
ToolbarIcon uses a 24 box inside a viewBox 0 0 24 24 svg sized 16px instead of a 0..16 box with paint viewBox 24; the rendered glyph is identical.
No styled tooltip and no DOM render test; visible-label removal is checked by review plus unit tests.
Wave-1 plans run workspace-wide typecheck while a sibling edits; a sibling-only diagnostic is recorded and re-run after the wave.
supportedEdgeCases: Font size at or beyond 8 or 72 disables the smaller or larger button; non-step sizes move to the neighbouring step.
Decoration combines to 'underline line-through' and clears to null, never 'none'.
Clicking the active horizontal or vertical alignment clears it to the default.
Vertical alignment row appears only when every selected leaf is text.note; groups are expanded through leafElements.
Simple mode hides Frame selection and boolean operations; Straighten and align actions appear only when enabled; disabled actions look disabled.
Escape closes the Text disclosure and refocuses its summary; pressing the canvas closes it; the toolbar hides while dragging.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Mixed formatting across leaves: pressed state reflects the first leaf only, as in the inspector.
Read-only handling beyond what the existing colour swatches do.
Hosted web app styling beyond the rules carried by SelectionToolbar.css.

acceptanceCriteria: text-format.ts exports DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE (13, from TEXT_NOTE_FONT_SIZE), FONT_SIZE_STEPS 8..72, MIN_FONT_SIZE, MAX_FONT_SIZE, TextFormatState, textFormatState, stepFontSize, fontSizePatch, boldPatch, italicPatch, decorationPatch, textAlignPatch, verticalAlignPatch and supportsVerticalAlign, with the signatures in the plan.

Bold writes 700 or null. Italic writes 'italic' or null. Decoration combines to 'underline line-through' and clears to null, never 'none'. Clicking the active textAlign or verticalAlign writes null. stepFontSize returns null beyond the bounds.
The module imports no Solid or DOM APIs, and text-format.test.ts covers every case listed in the plan.

acceptanceCriteria: ToolbarIcon.tsx exports TOOLBAR_ICONS as const, with exactly the 36 key-to-Lucide pairs in the plan, along with ToolbarIconKey and ToolbarIcon({ name }).
ToolbarIcon renders an aria-hidden 16px svg with viewBox 0 0 24 24 using findIcon and renderIconMarkup with currentColor stroke and no hand-drawn paths.
ToolbarIcon.test.ts fails when any TOOLBAR_ICONS value is missing from findIcon, and checks the exact key set and that values are unique.

sharedPathNotes.intendedEdit: Delete only the floating selection toolbar container rule and the .nodetto-float-group, .nodetto-float-colours and .nodetto-float-button rules (about lines 261-319). Keep every .nodetto-swatch rule.
Near line 399, describe the toolbar as icons with hover names and add one paragraph about the Text disclosure.

acceptanceCriteria: Every toolbar button and summary has only a ToolbarIcon child (the font-size <output> is the only text), with title equal to aria-label. Action buttons use actionTitle, and toggles expose aria-pressed.

The Text disclosure sits between Colors and Arrange. It uses leafElements and the first leaf's style for its state and writes only through editor.setSelectionStyle with the text-format patches. The vertical row shows only when supportsVerticalAlign is true.
Existing behaviour is unchanged: placeAbove and its test, hiding while pressed, Escape refocusing the summary, simple-mode guards, conditional Straighten and align buttons, and disabled states.

SelectionToolbar.css holds every toolbar rule, scoped under .nodetto-selection-toolbar, with 26px buttons and existing tokens with light fallbacks. theme-tokens.test.ts passes. panels.css no longer contains nodetto-float- rules.
docs/editing.md describes the icon toolbar and the Text disclosure.
